test_title: SSC CHSL 2025 Tier-1 (Held On: 12 Nov, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
**Choose the correct passive voice transformation of the sentence:**

The skilled programmer has written an elegant and efficient code to solve the intricate problem.

options.text: An elegant and efficient code was written by the skilled programmer to solve the intricate problem.
An elegant and efficient code has been written by the skilled programmer to solve the intricate problem.
An elegant and efficient code has been being written by the skilled programmer to solve the intricate problem.
An elegant and efficient code is written by the skilled programmer to solve the intricate problem.

solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. An elegant and efficient code has been written by the skilled programmer to solve the intricate problem. .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the **present perfect tense** ("has written").
 
• To convert it to passive voice, the structure of the present perfect tense changes as follows:
 
 
• **Active voice:** Subject + has/have + past participle + object.
 
• **Passive voice:** Object + has/have + been + past participle + by + subject.
 
 
 
• The subject in the active voice ("The skilled programmer") becomes the agent in the passive voice ("by the skilled programmer").
 
• The object in the active voice ("an elegant and efficient code") becomes the subject in the passive voice.

Correct transformation: *An elegant and efficient code has been written by the skilled programmer to solve the intricate problem.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Incorrect options:**
 
 
• **Option 1:** "An elegant and efficient code was written by the skilled programmer..." uses the past tense ("was written"), which is incorrect as the original sentence is in the present perfect tense.
 
• **Option 3:** "An elegant and efficient code has been being written..." is grammatically incorrect because "has been being" is rarely used and awkward in standard English.
 
• **Option 4:** "An elegant and efficient code is written by the skilled programmer..." uses the present simple tense ("is written"), which is incorrect as the original sentence is in the present perfect tense.
